linear_algebra/smith_form.rs.purpose: Produce finite integer Smith data D, U, V with checked aggregate workspace admission and a replayed U A V = D identity; retain separate sparse heuristic APIs with their existing scope.

smith_normal_form_checked/smith_normal_f.admission: Check m*n + m*m + n*n with checked usize arithmetic before dense workspace allocation. The default aggregate ceiling is 4096 cells; SmithLimits exposes an explicit override and a per-pivot pass limit. Overflow and admission failure return typed SmithError/MatrixError without mutating the input.
smith_normal_form_checked/smith_normal_f.postcondition: Successful output has positive Smith invariants in divisibility order, a diagonal matrix D, and integer transforms U,V satisfying U A V = D. Empty shapes are supported when their identity workspaces are admitted.
smith_normal_form_checked/smith_normal_f.iteration_policy: Count one pass only after finding a nonzero pivot. Refuse when the count equals max_pivot_iterations, before the next pass. An all-zero active block does not consume a pass.
invariants: The private workspace retains admitted rectangular row lengths and square transform dimensions. Pivot scans choose the first minimum nonzero absolute value in row-major order; swaps and sign normalization precede elimination.

Each subtract transform has determinant one. For Bezout coefficients xa+yb=g>0, the pair matrix [[x,y],[-b/g,a/g]] has determinant one. Row operations update U; column operations update the stored columns of V. A divisibility repair adds the same row to D and U.

All internal pair helpers receive first < second from k and a later index. split_at_mut therefore yields disjoint coordinates/rows within the admitted shape. Pivot divisors are nonzero; Bezout quotients are integral.
The iterative extended-Euclid loop strictly decreases nonzero remainder magnitude, has no recursion, and normalizes the final gcd sign. It preserves old_r=old_x*a+old_y*b.
smith_normal_form_checked/smith_normal_f.resource_boundary: Cell limits count D/U/V dense scalar slots and are not a bound on BigInt bit growth, aggregate process allocation, formatting or elapsed time. Each workspace row reservation is fallible. Scalar operations use borrowed inputs; pair updates avoid copying entire source rows.
smith_normal_form_checked/smith_normal_f.independent_challenge: 729 two-by-three integer matrices checked against determinantal divisors, transform determinants, 4225 signed Bezout inputs, a 2000-step Fibonacci Euclidean chain, inclusive aggregate budget tests, a huge zero-area metadata refusal, and a false-diagonal identity rejection.

SparseColMatrix.admission: Private sparse columns contain exactly cols vectors, each with strictly increasing row indices below rows and nonzero integer coefficients. new_checked sorts in place and rejects violations. Its unstable sort does not specify which error wins among equal-row entries containing multiple defects.
SparseColMatrix.mul_vec: Require input length cols before admitting rows output elements. Default output limit 4096; explicit inclusive override. Fallible reservation precedes zero initialization. Borrowed exact integer products accumulate into admitted row indices.
SparseColMatrix.dense_conversion: to_dense checks rows*cols and output budget before fallible allocation; from_dense checks 2*cols+nnz for overflow and storage admission before counters, column descriptors and entries. The two cols terms account for counters and descriptors; nonzeros are cloned once into pre-reserved columns.
SparseColMatrix.empty_shapes: Zero-area dense storage is preserved without enumerating huge row metadata. Zero-row sparse storage still requires column descriptors and counters; that metadata is included in admission.
SparseColMatrix.errors: ColumnCountMismatch, ShapeOverflow, StorageCountOverflow and wrapped MatrixError allocation-limit/reservation failures. Failed operations return no partial output and do not mutate inputs.
SparseColMatrix.api_change: from_dense now returns Result. The three preexisting Rust callers were adapted; two added challenge callers also handle Result. Consumers outside this repository require the same migration.
SparseColMatrix.challenge: 729 three-by-two matrices over {-1,0,1}, each multiplied by 25 independently enumerated integer vectors using direct i64 dot-product oracles; dense roundtrips; inclusive storage/vector/matrix budgets and usize::MAX empty-metadata/capacity refusals.
SparseColMatrix.resource_boundary: Element counts are not byte limits or bounds on BigInt allocation, total process memory or elapsed time.

homology/rank_certificate.rs.purpose: Admit finite rank certificates through canonical coefficients, dimensions, exact split identities and a fallible matrix binding.

RankCertificate::try_admit/check_split_i.postcondition: Admit coefficients, rank and shapes before checking M=UV, LU=I and VR=I in that order. Hash the matrix only after those identities pass. Factoring the identity phase preserves every refusal and keeps typed hash propagation.
RankCertificate::try_admit/check_split_i.scope: The private certificate remains an exact finite rank witness; the producer's elimination result is not trusted without replaying the identities.
RankCertificate::try_admit/check_split_i.zero_rank: After coefficient and complete shape admission, rank zero requires every input entry zero. U,V,L,R then have empty storage and LU=VR=I_0 is vacuous. Zero-area usize::MAX metadata is not enumerated.

certify_rank.postcondition: Canonical input only; produce a rank factorization and split maps, then replay the public checker before emitting a certificate. For zero matrices construct the four zero-area maps directly.
certify_rank.proof_argument: M=UV bounds rank(M)<=r; LU=I gives rank(U)>=r, and VR=I gives rank(V)>=r. Together rank(UV)=r. Rational Gram matrices U^T U are invertible for independent columns because sums of rational squares vanish only when each term is zero.
certify_rank.cost: Private rational_rref/rational_inverse use admitted, fallibly reserved flat buffers. Input and transpose copies are made once where ownership requires them; coordinates and inverse outputs move coefficients out of working storage. Pivot divisors and elimination factors move out of the row rather than cloning operands in its arithmetic loop. Conservative phase field-operation counts are charged without refunds; scalar bit sizes, validation, hashing, comparison, allocator internals and elapsed time are outside this count.

RankLimits/RankBudget.admission: Default limits are 4096 cells per matrix and 1000000 conservative scalar operations per producer/checker call. Explicit overrides are inclusive. Cell products, operation products and aggregate charges use checked usize arithmetic. Failed charges leave spent unchanged.
RankLimits/RankBudget.order: Producer admits input cells before canonical validation. Checker candidate admission validates canonical coefficients and shapes, then cells for input and all four maps. Positive-rank identity replay checks the sum of all three product work bounds before allocating I_r; individual products debit that same sum. verify_against checks input cells and binding before replay, without cloning the candidate.
RankLimits/RankBudget.zero: Canonical zero matrices require no field work; rank-zero maps have zero-area buffers, including usize::MAX by zero metadata. Nonzero storage remains subject to the cell limit.
RankLimits/RankBudget.limits: Counts are phase bounds, not an exact event counter, byte limit, BigInt bound, deadline or aggregate memory bound.

RationalRows/rational_rref/rational_inve.invariants: rows*cols equals flat storage length; width<=cols; selected pivots are nonzero. Earlier pivot columns are zero in every later pivot row. Normalization moves the pivot to an owned divisor and writes one; clear_row uses disjoint slices, moves its factor and writes zero. Remaining entries use borrowed exact Q arithmetic. All private ranges follow admitted shape and row bounds.
RationalRows/rational_rref/rational_inve.factorization: Pivot columns of the original M form U. The first rank rows of reduced M form V; truncating and moving the row buffer preserves M=UV. A full-column-rank Q matrix has positive-definite Gram matrix, giving L=(U^T U)^-1 U^T and the analogous section of V. Public identity replay is required before evidence construction.
RationalRows/rational_rref/rational_inve.inverse: Square check, checked 2n, per-matrix n*2n admission and conservative work charge precede augmented-buffer allocation. Reduction scans only the left n columns. Missing pivots return typed Singular. On success left block I proves the moved right block is the inverse.
RationalRows/rational_rref/rational_inve.cost: Reduction bound min(rows,width)*cols*(2*rows+1) counts at most cols divisions and rows*cols multiply/subtract pairs per pivot. Product bound is 2*rows*cols*inner. Both deliberately omit comparisons and coefficient representation costs.

determinant/rank/inverse and _with_limit.postcondition: Pivoted exact row elimination computes determinant with row-swap sign, rectangular rank, or square inverse. determinant(0x0)=1, rank(empty storage)=0, inverse(0x0)=0x0. Singular inverse returns SingularMatrix; nonsquare determinant/inverse return DimensionMismatch.
determinant/rank/inverse and _with_limit.invariant_argument: Row swaps and subtracting a scaled pivot row preserve row space; nonzero pivot scaling is invertible. Determinant accumulates pre-elimination pivots and swap parity. Gauss-Jordan on [A|I] yields [I|A^-1]. Private indexing is restricted to admitted row/column ranges; rank never exceeds rows or min(rows,cols).
determinant/rank/inverse and _with_limit.resource_policy: determinant/rank reserve one admitted input copy; inverse admits n*(2n) workspace before allocation, then moves the right block into output. Conservative elimination work is 3*rows*cols*min(rows,cols)+min(rows,cols), using augmented cols for inverse.

transpose/conjugate_transpose/trace/is_s.postcondition: Transpose swaps coordinates; conjugate transpose additionally conjugates entries. Trace sums the diagonal only for square matrices. transpose/conjugate_transpose/trace/is_s.cost: O(rows*cols) traversal for transpose/predicates and O(rows) for trace; transpose outputs are cell/work admitted, with constant-time zero-area metadata handling.

is_sl2_traceless.input_domain: All Ratio<i64> bit patterns produced by new/new_raw, including noncanonical or negative denominators.
is_sl2_traceless.postcondition: Return false if either denominator is zero; otherwise return (n1*d2 == -(n2*d1)) over mathematical integers.
is_sl2_traceless.bounds_argument: Each signed i64 product has magnitude at most 2^126. Widening before multiplication and comparing the negated product fit i128 without forming a potentially overflowing sum.
is_sl2_traceless.failure_behavior: Invalid rational candidates return false; there are no index accesses, allocations or division operations.
is_sl2_traceless.cost: Constant count of i128 operations and constant storage.

local_green_global_red_lggr/lggr_v.rs.purpose: Decide rank(QD) = rank(D) over exact rationals and return a separating witness when the ranks differ.
preconditions: D is m by n and Q is p by m; scalar arithmetic and row reduction are supplied by the pinned external linear-algebra provider.
The checked matrix provider must maintain its row-major shape/storage invariant. Raw report structs remain untrusted data.
required_admission_order: Refuse any zero input dimension as EmptyMatrix.
Refuse either input cell count above 4096 as BudgetUnknown.
Refuse q.rows*d.cols above 4096 before allocating the declared product.
Admit canonical rationals in D then Q: denominators positive and numerator/denominator already reduced. Return typed InvalidRational for any raw invalid candidate.

check_soundness.postcondition: For admitted matrices, sound iff rank(QD) equals rank(D). Unsound reports carry v with Dv != 0 and Q(Dv) = 0. authority_effect is None.
check_soundness.witness_production: Reuse QD's RREF and consider one free-column basis candidate at a time in ascending column order.

verify_unsoundness_witness.postcondition: Apply the same matrix admission before checking candidate length. Return false for incorrect length, then admit canonical witness coefficients or return InvalidRational. Return false when Dv = 0; otherwise return whether Q(Dv) = 0.

GaussianRational arithmetic and Involuti.postcondition: add, mul, neg, inherited sub and conjugate compute the Q(i) operations. norm_sq(a+bi)=a^2+b^2. try_inv returns None exactly for zero; otherwise it returns (a-bi)/(a^2+b^2). Inherited try_div returns None exactly for a zero divisor argument.
GaussianRational arithmetic and Involuti.invariant_argument: Canonical Q is a field. a^2+b^2=0 iff a=b=0 over Q, so the explicit zero check precedes both divisions. No operation can expose a mutable component or forge a denominator.

capability_assessment.basis: Executable production-grain syntax API replaces the entirely disabled recursive stub: private admitted storage, iterative grammar/depth validation, explicit token/name/depth/work limits, fallible output construction, capture/overflow refusals, and separate independent structural and allocation challenges. symbol_contracts.Token/arity/nonbinding_arity/eliminator_: A prefix token is one node. Lambda/Fst/Snd/Refl/NatSucc have one child; Pi/App/Sigma/Pair/Abort two; IdType three; BoolElim/NatElim four; variables, free names, universes and the unit/empty/bool/natural constants are leaves. Lambda binds its only child; Pi and Sigma bind their second child. Other children introduce no binder. Free names are opaque UTF-8 strings, including empty names. Universe u32 values are syntax labels, not universe-level proofs.
symbol_contracts.Term::try_new/check_tree/push_children: Require a nonempty token vector encoding exactly one prefix tree. A stack of pending child depths gives each token its validated binder depth. Reverse child scheduling preserves left-to-right prefix order. Every pending child needs a future token; reject a deficit before exceeding the once-reserved input-length stack. Reject trailing roots, checked-depth overflow, excessive depth/token/name/visit counts. Success has equal token/depth vector lengths and exact free-name byte sum; fields have no public mutation or unchecked decoder.
symbol_contracts.shift/check_shift/append_shifted/moved_v: At binder depth d, preserve variables below cutoff+d; shift the others by signed amount using checked unsigned magnitude arithmetic. Refuse arithmetic underflow/overflow and results below the active cutoff, preventing down-shift capture. Checked cutoff+depth overflow is a typed refusal. Constants/free names and tree grammar are preserved. Check all shift arithmetic and depth/work admission before output allocation.
symbol_contracts.substitute/instantiate/check_substitutio: At input binder depth d, replace Var(index+d); decrement strictly larger variables once; preserve smaller variables. Each replacement is one admitted tree. instantiate is substitution at context index zero on the scope body without its outer Lambda. Preflight all output sizes, free-name bytes, replacement lifting and work/depth admission before output allocation.
symbol_contracts.check_replacement/lifted_variable/append: At internal replacement depth e, preserve variables below e and add the input depth d to every other variable. Output metadata is d+e. This preserves replacement-local bindings while lifting only its free variables past input binders. Overflow is refused before output construction.
symbol_contracts.SubstitutionSize/substitution_size/admit: For n input tokens, k target occurrences and m replacement tokens, output tokens are n-k+k*m; output free-name bytes are input bytes+k*replacement bytes. Reserve both output vectors once. Free-name contents are copied once per required output occurrence using fallible String reservation; other token clones have no heap payload. Private pushes stay within precomputed exact counts. A failed copy drops local partial buffers without mutating either input. Actual copy work includes the total output UTF-8 name bytes B_out; token-visit counters do not count each copied byte.
symbol_contracts.TermLimits/admit/add/mul/reserve/Substit: Inclusive defaults: 4096 tokens, 1048576 free-name bytes, binder depth 1024 and 1000000 conservative token visits. Constructor visits n; shift 2*n; substitution 3*n+2*k*m, accounting for count, validation and copy scans. Child scheduling is bounded by four children per token. All count/variable/depth arithmetic is checked. Limits describe local representations and work units; candidate parsing, allocator internals, process memory and elapsed time are not bounded.

proof_arguments: Prefix validation starts with exactly one pending root. Popping one slot and pushing precisely the token arity preserves the frontier invariant. An exhausted frontier before tokens end is a trailing root; a missing future-node deficit is an incomplete tree. Every accepted token therefore has one uniquely determined tree position/depth.
Shift changes only variable labels, preserving grammar and depth metadata. Checked arithmetic and changed>=active-cutoff preserve the admitted variable domain without capture.

Substitution replaces each target leaf by one complete prefix tree. Input bound variables are below index+d and remain unchanged. Decrementing a larger variable cannot cross depth d. Replacement variables below their local depth stay bound locally; the other variables are lifted by d and cannot be captured. Exact output counts prove all private vector pushes fit reserved buffers.

Every production traversal is iterative. Allocated buffers and immutable inputs are disjoint; an error publishes no Term and drops partial local storage. Scalar integer additions/products are checked, or bounded by admitted vector lengths and occurrence counts.

symbol_contracts.Arrow/FiniteCategory::try_new/admit_cate: Objects are 0..objects and arrows 0..m. identities has exactly objects entries. composition has m*m row-major cells, with [f*m+g] meaning g after f. Checked table-cell and conservative check-work admission precede law scans. symbol_contracts.check_endpoints/check_object/check_ident: Every arrow endpoint is an admitted object. Identity(object) is an in-range endomorphism of that object. A table cell is Some exactly when target(f)=source(g); its result is an in-range arrow from source(f) to target(g). Noncomposable cells must be None. Thus table indexing and every successful returned arrow are justified by the complete admitted shape/domain.
symbol_contracts.check_units/check_associativity/check_as: For every arrow f, f after id_source and id_target after f equal f. For every composable triple f,g,h, h after (g after f) equals (h after g) after f. Endpoint closure ensures both sides are defined. Finite iteration checks all instances; no sample replaces a required table instance.

symbol_contracts.QuasiCategory::from_category/category/si: A QuasiCategory is constructed only from admitted category evidence. simplex requires a valid start object and in-range composable arrow path under the stored edge limit. Copy path edges only after checking all domains and adjacency. This constructs the category nerve by composable strings; no mutable verification flag exists.
symbol_contracts.NerveSimplex::dimension/start/edges/cate: Private path data is bound by lifetime to its immutable admitted category. A d-simplex has d edges and d+1 vertices. Vertex zero is start; vertex i>0 is target(edge[i-1]). Out-of-range vertex requests return a specific typed error.
symbol_contracts.NerveSimplex::face/face_edges: A zero-simplex has no face in this nonaugmented nerve. For d>=1 accept 0..=d: face zero drops the first edge and advances start; face d drops the last edge; an inner face composes adjacent edges in the declared order. Allocate exactly d-1 output edges fallibly. Private index ranges follow 0<=face<=d and admitted path invariants.
symbol_contracts.NerveSimplex::degeneracy/edge_buffer/cop: Accept vertex 0..=d, check d+1 edge count and its inclusive stored limit before allocation, then insert that vertex object identity. Output paths preserve endpoints/composability by the checked unit laws. Every copied path reserves its exact final length once; source/category borrows remain immutable on success and error.

Input vector allocation/parsing is outside constructor admission.

symbol_contracts.PrimeField::try_new/modulus/sum/product/: Admit precisely the prime u16 moduli using trial division through floor(sqrt(p)); refuse 0, 1 and composites before remainder operations. Private arithmetic receives only residues a,b<p. Sum/difference use u32, product uses u64; intermediate bounds are below 2p and p^2 respectively. Remainders are canonical u16. Negative is zero or p-a. Divisor squares are bounded by 256^2 in u32.
symbol_contracts.StrictAInfinity::try_new/admit_tables/ch: Move owned degree/differential/product vectors into a private immutable carrier only after modulus, checked n^2+n^3 cell/work and shape admission and canonical coefficients. Differential is row-major d[input*n+output]; product is m[(left*n+right)*n+output]. Validate nonzero coefficient grading and every basis instance of d^2, signed Leibniz and associativity before success. No unverified callback, decoder or public field can bypass admission.
symbol_contracts.check_grading/check_d_degree/check_produ: Nonzero d_ij requires degree(j)=degree(i)+1; nonzero m_ijk requires degree(k)=degree(i)+degree(j). Degree additions are checked i32. Zero coefficients impose no unnecessary degree arithmetic. Grading is cohomological.
symbol_contracts.check_d_squared/d_squared_coefficient: For each input i and output o, require sum_j d(i,j)d(j,o)=0 in F_p. A nonzero residue returns DifferentialSquared with its basis witness.
symbol_contracts.check_leibniz/check_leibniz_row/leibniz_: For each left a, right b and output o require sum_j m(a,b,j)d(j,o)-sum_j d(a,j)m(j,b,o)-(-1)^degree(a)sum_j d(b,j)m(a,j,o)=0. Signed parity uses rem_euclid(2), including negative degrees. Return a typed Leibniz witness on failure.

consumer_review: The local lib.rs and compatibility mod.rs expose this module. Repository Rust search found legacy algebra/morphism/formality symbols only inside the formerly wholly disabled source. No runnable legacy API compatibility is claimed.

The main Rust library reexports the local package. Current scoped evidence compiles the same local package in the audit workspace, including integration observers. It does not imply a fresh full main-workspace build.
The implementation uses Rust core/std only and forbids unsafe code. There is no external field implementation, dynamic dispatch, mutable global carrier, or unadmitted algebra callback.
proof_arguments: A u16 prime p is nonzero. Canonical residues are closed under the widened arithmetic/remainder operations, with maximum product below 2^32 and sum/difference below 2^17. No native overflow or division by zero is reachable in private field operations. Trial division is complete for composites and its counter/square fit u32.

Checked n^2 and n^3 table sizes and owned vector lengths prove every private dense index fits usize and its table. All basis iterators and public index gates stay below n. The zero-dimensional case executes no dense lookup. Degree arithmetic is checked exactly where a nonzero coefficient imposes a constraint.

Admission exhausts every basis instance of the three multilinear laws. Linearity extends them to all vectors. With m0=0,m1=d,m2=product and all higher operations zero, the cohomological Stasheff identities are d^2, graded Leibniz and associativity for n=1,2,3. At n>=4 each nested term contains an operation other than m1/m2 and vanishes. This argument establishes only this strict subset.

An Operation borrows its immutable source algebra for its entire lifetime, so it cannot mix tables or outlive the carrier. Public coefficient and basis checks exclude forged lookups in safe Rust. Query shape/domain/resource preflight precedes the single output reservation. try_reserve_exact maps capacity/allocation refusal to a typed error and all later pushes are within reserved length. Errors mutate no input and publish no partial carrier/output.
